entities.title: Buying equipment from a list
entities.summary: The equipment panel lists the offered items instead of number entry; same purchases, refusals and effects.
entities.context: UI-DESIGN's equipment panel differs from RULES' shop prompt.
entities.decision: buy takes the item, and the mount for a laser, as arguments; the panel stays open after a refusal (deliberate difference 12).
entities.rationale: The same outcomes as the baseline's shop, in LodeStar's own interface.
